modules.name: devtools
modules.description: Python, Node.js, C/C++ toolchain, Docker, VS Code-ready
modules.post_install: for u in $(getent group sudo | cut -d: -f4 | tr ',' ' '); do usermod -aG docker "$u"; done; echo 'Log out and back in to use Docker without sudo.'

modules.name: creative
modules.description: GIMP, Inkscape, Blender, Kdenlive, Audacity, darktable

modules.name: gaming
modules.description: Steam, gamepad support, extra Vulkan/32-bit drivers
modules.notes: Lutris, GameMode, MangoHud and Wine are already part of PRIMERS OS.

modules.name: cyber
modules.description: nmap, Wireshark, tcpdump, aircrack-ng, John, Hydra, sqlmap
modules.warning: Use these tools only on systems you own or have explicit written permission to test.

modules.name: ai-ml
modules.description: Jupyter, NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, Matplotlib, PyTorch

modules.name: voice
modules.description: Voice commands for the PRIMERS Brain (microphone support)

modules.name: macos-compat
modules.notes: Darling is not packaged for Ubuntu 22.04. See https://docs.darlinghq.org/build-instructions.html - it runs command-line macOS tools only.
modules.post_install: echo 'Darling must be built from source: https://docs.darlinghq.org/build-instructions.html'
